---
title: Tokens
description: Twelve variables. They are defined on `.ui`. Components read no other colors or fonts.
kicker: Docs
---

These variables are defined on the scope class `.ui`. Components only read them.

`--ui-bg` `--ui-fg` `--ui-muted` `--ui-faint` `--ui-line` `--ui-accent` `--ui-font-display` `--ui-font-text` `--ui-font-meta` `--ui-ease` `--ui-dur` `--ui-radius`

Colors use `light-dark()` and follow the system. Set `data-theme="light"` or `data-theme="dark"` on the element or an ancestor to force one. The footer's light / dark control sets `data-theme` on `<html>`, and the scope follows.

The scope is a class, not the page. Add `class="ui"` to a region and that region uses these tokens.

To take the tokens without the components, import `@froq/ui/tokens.css` on its own.

`pnpm check:tokens` checks that every variable is defined.
